state.paragraph: On August 27, 2013, BofA Merrill Lynch, as instructed by the Special Committee, sent a letter to each of Party A, Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona instructing such bidders to submit revised written proposals no later than September 9, 2013 if such bidders wished to proceed further in the process to pursue an in-depth evaluation of Mac-Gray with the objective of making a revised offer. The letter requested that the revised proposals address, among other things, valuation, sources and structures of financing, regulatory approvals and other post-signing covenants and focus areas for due diligence.

criteria.row_27: 08/06/2013 to 08/27/2013 | Mac-Gray | Other material event | Information access differs by bidder type: B and C (financial) get broad data-room access; A and CSC/Pamplona (strategic) get limited access, customer data withheld, plus synergy talks. All four had management presentations 08/06-08/14.
criteria.row_28: 08/27/2013 | Mac-Gray (BofA Merrill Lynch) | Deadline set | Letter to all four (authorized 08/15): revised written proposals due 09/09/2013 to go on to in-depth evaluation. Proposals to cover valuation, financing, approvals, covenants and diligence.
criteria.row_29: 09/09/2013 | CSC/Pamplona | Bid | price 19.5 | Revised IOI, up from $18.50 (#18). Pamplona commits 100% of the capital. Requests 2-week exclusivity. Heavy: customer data still withheld and further in-depth diligence expected.
criteria.row_30: 09/09/2013 | Party B | Bid | price 18.5 | Revised IOI, up from $17.00-$18.00 (#21). Financing from affiliated-fund equity plus third-party debt; no firm financing commitment (Heavy).
criteria.row_31: 09/09/2013 | Mac-Gray | Deadline | Due date for revised written proposals. CSC/Pamplona and Party B bid on time; Party A and Party C bid on 09/10 and were reviewed on 09/11 (late bids accepted).
criteria.row_32: 09/10/2013 | Party A | Bid | price 18-19 | Revised IOI, one day late; same range as its 06/21 proposal (#7). To be financed by existing credit facilities or affiliated equity; no firm financing commitment (Heavy).
criteria.row_33: 09/10/2013 | Party C | Bid | price 16-17 | Revised oral IOI to BofA, one day late; revises #24 ($16.00-$16.50). No firm financing commitment (Heavy).
criteria.none: None of the ledger rows records the event reported in the target sentence, either as the row's own event or in its note.
criteria.not_an_event: The target sentence reports no discrete event of these kinds (background, reasoning, description or discussion only).

match.instructions: `target_sentence` (from a merger filing; `paragraph` gives context) appears to report that the target or its banker sets, changes or communicates a bid deadline, process letter or request for final offers; or the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted. Each option describes one row of a research ledger as date | party | event | note. Select the row that records the event reported in `target_sentence`: same party or group, same action, consistent date and terms, allowing paraphrase and allowing the event to be summarised in a row's note. A related event with a different party, date or action does not count.
